title: Empty-Market Share Inflation
summary: A share vault prices deposits off its live asset balance, so a direct transfer (donation) inflates the share price and rounds a later deposit down to almost nothing. Deposits and redemptions must stay fair, and a donation must not let one depositor seize another's funds.

realWorld.incident: Hundred Finance / Sonne Finance (Compound-fork empty-market share inflation), 2023
realWorld.lossReported: ~$7M (Hundred Finance, Apr 2023) and ~$20M (Sonne, May 2024) across related empty-market / donation issues
realWorld.note: Re-implemented from the public description of the empty-market share-inflation class; no protocol code copied.
